passage:
Zoos and aquariums have changed a lot over the years. They used to be just places to show off wild animals, but now they focus more on research and protecting endangered species. Supporters say these places help save animals from dying out through breeding programs and science work. For many city dwellers, visiting a zoo is their only real link to nature. It helps kids learn to care about the environment. Fans also point out that ticket sales raise important money to protect natural habitats from poachers and climate change.

On the other side, animal rights activists argue that keeping animals locked up is always cruel. They believe that no man-made enclosure can ever match the huge spaces and natural family groups animals have in the wild. Critics point out that many captive animals show signs of stress, such as pacing in circles or living shorter lives—especially big animals like orcas and elephants. From this viewpoint, seeing a sad animal behind glass is not worth taking away its freedom and natural life.

The debate often comes down to the difference between "sanctuaries" and regular zoos. Sanctuaries focus on taking care of the individual animal and do not breed them or put on shows. Meanwhile, many zoos rely on cute baby animals, like panda cubs, to bring in crowds and money. Skeptics say that if zoos really cared about conservation, they would use virtual reality or focus only on helping local wildlife instead of flying exotic animals around the world. They believe true conservation happens in nature, not in cages.

As public opinions change, many zoos are being forced to adapt or shut down. Some are trying to breed animals and release them back into the wild, but this is a slow, costly process with no guarantee of work. The future of zoos depends on proving they are truly needed to save wildlife, rather than just being a form of entertainment. The big question is: can we justify locking up a few animals to save the species, or is captivity too high a price to pay just to satisfy human curiosity?
